owner.title: Kkes amiḍan-iw
owner.description: Ad yemdel asalun-ik deg Saloneo, syin ad ttwakksen yisefka-s deffir 30 wussan.
owner.done: Amiḍan-ik yemdel. Ad yettwakkes i lebda deg 30 wussan.

points.now: Seg tura, ur tettizmireḍ ara ad tkecmeḍ, asebter-ik n tuṭṭfa d tfelwit-ik deg ukaram ad ffren, ikcumen n terbaɛt-ik ad ttwagzmen.
points.later: Deg 30 wussan, imsaɣen-ik, timlilin, imeẓla, ifarisen, terbaɛt d tewlafin-ik ad ttwakksen i lebda.
points.kept: Isefka n uxelleṣ i ɣ-d-yettak usaḍuf ad ten-neḥrez (tiwsatin, isiwilen, tiludna, ajerred) ad qqimen, war ismawen war tansiwin.
points.undo: Tbeddleḍ ṛṛay? Aru-yaɣ-d ɣer {{email}} send ad fakken 30 wussan.

staff.title: Kkes anekcum-iw
staff.description: Ad yekkes asulay-ik n unekcum ɣer usalun-a.

points.now: Anekcum-ik ad yettwakkes tura kan: ur tettizmireḍ ara ad tkecmeḍ.
points.team: Tafelwit-ik deg terbaɛt, aɣawas-ik d timlilin-ik ad qqimen ɣer usalun, d netta i ten-yettsefrayen.
points.again: I wakken ad d-terreḍ anekcum, suter tinubga tamaynutt seg usalun.
